lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kaaraj tin ke sidh hahi jin guramukh kirapaa dhaar ||
lines.translation: All the Gurmukh's affairs are brought to perfect completion; the Lord has showered him with His Mercy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jo dhur mile se mil rahe har mele sirajanahaar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who meets the Primal Lord remains blended with the Lord, the Creator Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: too sachaa saahib sach hai sach sachaa gosaaee ||
lines.translation: You are True, O True Lord and Master. You are the Truest of the True, O Lord of the World.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਸਭ ਧਿਆਇਦੀ ਸਭ ਲਗੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudhuno sabh dhiaaidee sabh lagai teree paaee ||
lines.translation: Everyone meditates on You; everyone falls at Your Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸੁਆਲਿਉ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: teree siphat suaaliu saroop hai jin keetee tis paar laghaaee ||
lines.translation: Your Praises are graceful and beautiful; You save those who speak them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukhaa no phal paaidaa sach naam samaaee ||
lines.translation: You reward the Gurmukhs, who are absorbed in the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਵਡੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: vade mere saahibaa vadee teree vadiaaee ||1||
lines.translation: O my Great Lord and Master, great is Your glorious greatness. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin naavai hor salaahanaa sabh bolan phikaa saad ||
lines.translation: Without the Name, all other praise and speech is insipid and tasteless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਲਾਹਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਵਾਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh aha(n)kaar salaahade haumai mamataa vaad ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs praise their own egos; their attachment to egotism is useless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਸੇ ਮਰਹਿ ਖਪਿ ਜਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਵਾਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin saalaahan se marahi khap jaavai sabh apavaad ||
lines.translation: Those whom they praise, die; they all waste away in conflict.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਮਾਨਾਦੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak guramukh ubare jap har har paramaanaad ||1||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Embodiment of Supreme Bliss. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur har prabh das naam dhiaaee man haree ||
lines.translation: O True Guru, tell me of my Lord God, that I may meditate on the Naam within my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਹਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam pavit har mukh bolee sabh dukh paraharee ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord's Name is sacred and pure; chanting it, all my pain has been taken away. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: too aape aap nira(n)kaar hai nira(n)jan har raaiaa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are the Formless Lord, the Immaculate Lord, our Sovereign King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਤੂ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee too ik man sach dhiaaiaa tin kaa sabh dukh gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on You, O True Lord with one-pointed mind, are rid of all their pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਵੈ ਲਾਇ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa sareek ko naahee jis no lavai laai sunaaiaa ||
lines.translation: You have no equal, next to whom I might sit and speak of You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh jevad daataa toohai nira(n)janaa toohai sach merai man bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: You are the only Giver as great as Yourself. You are Immaculate; O True Lord, you are pleasing to my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sache mere saahibaa sache sach naaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: O my True Lord and Master, Your Name is the Truest of the True. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੁਰਜਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man a(n)tar haumai rog hai bhram bhoole manamukh durajanaa ||
lines.translation: Deep within the mind is the disease of ego; the self-willed manmukhs, the evil beings, are deluded by doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak rog gavaai mil satigur saadhoo sajanaa ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, this disease is eradicated, only when one meets the True Guru, our Holy Friend. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan rataa ra(n)g siu guramukh har gunataas ||
lines.translation: The mind and body of the Gurmukh are imbued with the Love of the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har saranaagatee har mele gur saabaas ||2||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak has taken to the Sanctuary of the Lord. Hail to the Guru, who has united me with the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਵੜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: too karataa purakh aga(n)m hai kis naal too vaReeai ||
lines.translation: You are the Personification of Creativity, the Inaccessible Lord. With whom should I compare You?

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਹਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਪੜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh jevad hoi s aakheeai tudh jehaa toohai paReeai ||
lines.translation: If there was anyone else as great as You, I would name him; You alone are like Yourself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗੜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: too ghat ghat ik varatadaa guramukh paragaReeai ||
lines.translation: You are the One, permeating each and every heart; You are revealed to the Gurmukh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਭਸ ਦਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਤੂ ਚੜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: too sachaa sabhas daa khasam hai sabh doo too chaReeai ||
lines.translation: You are the True Lord and Master of all; You are the Highest of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਸਚੇ ਹੋਇਸੀ ਤਾ ਕਾਇਤੁ ਕੜੀਐ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: too karahi s sache hoisee taa kaait kaReeai ||3||
lines.translation: Whatever You do, O True Lord - that is what happens, so why should we grieve? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕਾ ਅਠੇ ਪਹਰ ਲਗੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai man tan prem pira(n)m kaa athe pahar laga(n)n ||
lines.translation: My mind and body are imbued with the Love of my Beloved, twenty-four hours a day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੰਨਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kirapaa dhaar prabh satigur sukh vasa(n)n ||1||
lines.translation: Shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, O God, that he may dwell in peace with the True Guru. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕੀ ਜਿਉ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਤਿਵੈ ਸੋਹੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin a(n)dar preet pira(n)m kee jiu bolan tivai soha(n)n ||
lines.translation: Those whose inner beings are filled with the Love of their Beloved, look beautiful as they speak.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਲਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਰੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har aape jaanadaa jin laaee preet pira(n)n ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Himself knows all; the Beloved Lord has infused His Love. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਹੈ ਭੁਲਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: too karataa aap abhul hai bhulan vich naahee ||
lines.translation: O Creator Lord, You Yourself are infallible; You never make mistakes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਸਚੇ ਭਲਾ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: too karahi s sache bhalaa hai gur sabad bujhaahee ||
lines.translation: Whatever You do is good, O True Lord; this understanding is obtained through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: too karan kaaran samarath hai doojaa ko naahee ||
lines.translation: You are the Cause of causes, the All-powerful Lord; there is no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: too saahib agam daiaal hai sabh tudh dhiaahee ||
lines.translation: O Lord and Master, You are inaccessible and merciful. Everyone meditates on You.
